text:
rachel: Quick ask from PM: we need a lean migration playbook for the v1->v2 deprecation. Deliverables: 1) one-line site banner, 2) migration one-pager with 3 side-by-side snippets (py/ts/go), 3) model mapping note (embeddings dim callout), 4) PR template + smoke checklist. Target: 2025-05-30 morning publish. Who can pick this up?
kevin: I can do the PR template + GH action for link-checks. Will add labels: docs-deprecate, needs-smoke.
sophie: I'll write the migration one-pager and include a short model-equivalence table and a note about reindexing when embed dims change.
mike: I'll produce the language snippets and a tiny temporary shim example. Important to call out API surface rename: `client.models.invoke` -> `client.responses.create` and the input shape change to a chat-array. Example:```
# v1
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hello")
# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}])
```
Also add a shim:```
def invoke_v1_compat(client, model_id, text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=[{"role":"user","content": text}])
```
Mark as short-lived.
infra-bot: automation hint: once model mapping doc lands we can auto-generate redirects for /v1/** pages to the mapped /v2/** pages; otherwise add a banner to unmapped pages. Recommend fail CI on docs PRs if a /v1/* page is left unmapped.
rachel: Banner copy (one line): "Deprecation Notice: v1 API will be retired on 2025-06-01. See migration guide." Short and linkable.
kevin: Template checklist I'll include: summary, files changed, snippets updated (Y/N), smoke test artifact URL, redirect entries, reviewer, release-notes blurb. Will push template PR tonight.
sophie: Model example row: `old-embed-512 -> redwood-embed-1024` with note: "vector dimension change; reindex vectors or use alias fallback for a limited window." Adding a short 'what breaks' bullet list.
mike: Streaming quick note: SSE event names changed (old: `event: chunk`, `event: done` -> new: `event: response.delta`, `event: response.complete`). I'll update streaming snippet and run a staging smoke test.
infra-bot: scheduled reminder set for 2025-05-28 10:00 UTC to verify redirects and banner staging.
rachel: Thanks—split: kevin = PR template+automation, sophie = migration page+model map, mike = snippets+streaming checks. Post PR links here and I'll assemble a top-level playbook that points to each PR and wires the redirect generator. If smoke tests fail, tag #eng-oncall. :white_check_mark:
